sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: I don't have a favorite podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我没有最喜欢的播客。

sentences.en: It'd be too unfair.
sentences.zh: 那样太不公平了。

sentences.en: There are too many I like.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢的播客太多了。

sentences.en: It is hard to choose just one.
sentences.zh: 很难只选出一个。

sentences.en: But when people ask me that question,
sentences.zh: 但当人们问我这个问题时，

sentences.en: I always make sure to mention the Radiotopia show Song Exploder.
sentences.zh: 我总会提到Radiotopia旗下的节目《歌曲解析》（Song Exploder）。

sentences.en: I think it is the perfect concept for a podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为它是播客节目的完美构思。

sentences.en: If you haven't heard it, my friend Rishikeshiwe,
sentences.zh: 如果你还没听过，我的朋友瑞希·凯什韦（Hrishikesh Hirway），

sentences.en: he interviews musical artists and gets them to break down a song into its component parts
sentences.zh: 他会采访音乐人，让他们把一首歌拆解成各个组成部分，

sentences.en: to show how it all came together.
sentences.zh: 来展示这首歌是如何创作出来的。

sentences.en: It's recently been adapted into a Netflix TV show.
sentences.zh: 最近它还被改编成了Netflix的电视节目。

sentences.en: It's so much fun to watch.
sentences.zh: 看起来非常有意思。

sentences.en: I hope you check it out.
sentences.zh: 我希望你去看看。

sentences.en: And we love Song Exploder here on the show so much that in a meeting a few months ago,
sentences.zh: 我们节目组也非常喜欢《歌曲解析》，以至于几个月前的一次会议上，

sentences.en: we thought, well, what if we tried to do that for one of our own songs?
sentences.zh: 我们想，嗯，如果我们试着为自己的歌曲做同样的事会怎样？

sentences.en: You might know that we have our own composer here at 99PI.
sentences.zh: 你可能知道我们在《99%隐形》有自己的作曲家。

sentences.en: Her name is Sean Rial.
sentences.zh: 她叫肖恩·里亚尔（Sean Rial）。

sentences.en: And hiring her was one of the best decisions I ever made.
sentences.zh: 聘用她是我做过的最正确的决定之一。

sentences.en: I love that we have our own in-house composer.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴我们有自己的内部作曲家。

sentences.en: I love working with Sean.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢和肖恩共事。

sentences.en: And Sean works with all the producers to score our episodes with original music.
sentences.zh: 肖恩与所有制作人合作，为我们的剧集配上原创音乐。

sentences.en: That she writes and records right here in Oakland.
sentences.zh: 这些音乐都是她在奥克兰创作并录制的。

sentences.en: So, on this episode, we are bringing you a tribute to the brilliant podcast Song Exploder
sentences.zh: 所以，在这一期节目中，我们将向出色的播客《歌曲解析》

sentences.en: and our brilliant composer, Sean Rial.
sentences.zh: 以及我们出色的作曲家肖恩·里亚尔致敬。

sentences.en: And we're calling it Sean Exploder.
sentences.zh: 我们把它称为《肖恩解析》（Sean Exploder）。

sentences.en: It's the story of a song that Sean wrote for Avery Truffleman back when she worked here.
sentences.zh: 这是肖恩为艾弗里·特鲁夫曼（Avery Truffleman）在职时写的一首歌的故事。

sentences.en: It's called The Loom.
sentences.zh: 它叫《织布机》（The Loom）。

sentences.en: And it's the first song in Avery's spinoff series, Articles of IntereSt.
sentences.zh: 这是艾弗里衍生系列《兴趣文章》（Articles of Interest）中的第一首歌。

sentences.en: And to tell the story of the song, you really need to start at the beginning of Avery and Sean's relationship.
sentences.zh: 要讲这首歌的故事，真的得从艾弗里和肖恩关系的起点说起。

sentences.en: I'll let Sean take it from here.
sentences.zh: 接下来交给肖恩来讲。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Sean Rial.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是肖恩·里亚尔。

sentences.en: I'm the composer for 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 我是《99%隐形》的作曲家。

sentences.en: I've been with the show for four years now, but before that, I was playing music in bands and making a living walking dogs.
sentences.zh: 我加入这个节目已经四年了，但在那之前，我一直在乐队里玩音乐，靠遛狗为生。

sentences.en: Dog walking is actually mostly driving and picking up dogs.
sentences.zh: 遛狗其实大部分时间是在开车和接狗。

sentences.en: So, like, a lot of listening to stuff in the car.
sentences.zh: 所以，在车里听了很多东西。

sentences.en: And at a certain point, you just, like, get, like, sick of music.
sentences.zh: 到了一定程度，你就会，呃，对音乐感到厌倦。

sentences.en: So, that's when I started, like, religiously listening to podcasts and I couldn't, like, refresh the feed fast enough.
sentences.zh: 所以，那时我开始如饥似渴地听播客，简直恨不得刷新频率再快一点。

sentences.en: And the music was a big part of it, too.
sentences.zh: 音乐也是其中很重要的一部分。

sentences.en: Like, I think, like, that was a big part of, like, what made it feel like this new kind of art for me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，那也是让我觉得这对我来说是一种全新艺术形式的重要原因。

sentences.en: And part of me thought, like, I could write that music.
sentences.zh: 我曾想过，我也能写那种音乐。

sentences.en: But then I thought, you know, they'd probably just pull from some music library or something.
sentences.zh: 但后来我想，你知道，他们可能只是从某个音乐库里随便抽几首。

sentences.en: There's not, like, one person who writes music for podcasts.
sentences.zh: 并没有什么专门为播客写音乐的人。

sentences.en: And so then I would kind of just put it out of my head.
sentences.zh: 于是我就把这个念头抛诸脑后了。

sentences.en: I was getting to a point where working all day and then, you know, like, going home and trying to find the energy to work on music with my bands, a little teeth in basement.
sentences.zh: 当时我正处于一种状态：整天工作，然后回家，还要努力挤出精力去和我的乐队做音乐，就像在地下室里磨牙一样。

sentences.en: Like, the sustainability had run out.
sentences.zh: 那种可持续性已经耗尽了。

sentences.en: I was emotionally and energetically bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 我在情感和精力上都破产了。

sentences.en: It's, like, trying to be, like, there has to be a way out of this without, like, writing a hit song that's going to make me rich and famous.
sentences.zh: 就像在想，一定有办法摆脱这种困境，而不必非要写出一首让我变得富有和出名的热门歌曲。

sentences.en: Like, there has to be a way to make this a living.
sentences.zh: 一定有办法以此为生。

sentences.en: And then I met Avery.
sentences.zh: 然后我遇到了艾弗里。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Avery Truffleman.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是艾弗里·特鲁夫曼。

sentences.en: I am the host of the podcast The Cut from New York Magazine.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约杂志》旗下播客《The Cut》的主持人。

sentences.en: But for most of my life, I worked at 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 但我人生中大部分时间都在《99%隐形》工作。

sentences.en: Sean and I met on OKCupid, which is now considered, like, the old-fashioned way to meet someone.
sentences.zh: 我和肖恩是在OKCupid上认识的，这在现在被认为是认识人的老派方式了。

sentences.en: It's, like, quaint when you hear that someone met on OKCupid.
sentences.zh: 当你听说有人在OKCupid上认识时，会觉得很古雅。

sentences.en: It's like, oh, that's romance.
sentences.zh: 就像，哦，那真是浪漫。

sentences.en: You had to read a whole profile.
sentences.zh: 你得读完整个个人资料。

sentences.en: One of the stupid questions OKCupid asks you is, like, what's the first thing people notice about you?
sentences.zh: OKCupid问你的那些愚蠢问题之一是，人们对你的第一印象是什么？

sentences.en: And I was like, my voice.
sentences.zh: 我回答说，我的声音。

sentences.en: And I think Sean responded and said something.
sentences.zh: 我想肖恩回复并说了些什么。

sentences.en: I'm like, you know, I have a pretty signature voice, too.
sentences.zh: 我说，你知道，我的声音也很有辨识度。

sentences.en: And so we started sharing these voice memos back and forth for, like, a long time before we ever met.
sentences.zh: 于是我们在见面之前，就这么来来回回发了很长时间的语音备忘录。

sentences.en: We had this very, like, radio courtship.
sentences.zh: 我们有一种非常，呃，电台式的求爱过程。

sentences.en: I remember, like, walking down to the office, like, walking down Telegraph Avenue, three miles.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时走去办公室，沿着电报大道走，走了三英里。

sentences.en: Like, blah, blah, blah, like, leaving voice memos for Sean.
sentences.zh: 一边走一边给肖恩留语音备忘录。

sentences.en: One time I was, like, just recording a voice memo.
sentences.zh: 有一次我正在录语音备忘录。

sentences.en: And then I looked at it and I was like, oh, God, this is 45 minutes.
sentences.zh: 录完一看，天哪，有45分钟长。

sentences.en: I'm about to, like, send a 45-minute voice memo.
sentences.zh: 我居然要发一条45分钟的语音备忘录。

sentences.en: And I texted you and I was like, this is 45 minutes.
sentences.zh: 我给你发短信说，这有45分钟长。

sentences.en: Is this too much?
sentences.zh: 这太夸张了吗？

sentences.en: And you responded, you know, I'm about to get on the plane.
sentences.zh: 你回复说，我正要上飞机。

sentences.en: Please send it now.
sentences.zh: 请现在就发过来。

sentences.en: I need something to listen to.
sentences.zh: 我需要点东西听。

sentences.en: I distinctly remember that.
sentences.zh: 我清楚地记得那件事。

sentences.en: I distinctly remember being like, download, download, download, like, before the plane took off.
sentences.zh: 我清楚地记得当时在飞机起飞前，一直在点下载、下载、下载。

sentences.en: Like, we were, it was so fun.
sentences.zh: 那真的太有趣了。

sentences.en: Yeah, so we, like, exchanged voice memos for a long, long time before ever meeting.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们在见面之前交换了很长很长时间的语音备忘录。

sentences.en: And then we finally met.
sentences.zh: 然后我们终于见面了。

sentences.en: And I spent a lot of time, like, hanging out in Sean's house, going to Sean's shows, like, getting to know all the band drama of Sean's band.
sentences.zh: 我花了很多时间在肖恩家闲逛，去看肖恩的演出，了解她乐队里的各种戏剧性事件。

sentences.en: We dated, I think it was four months.
sentences.zh: 我们约会了，我想大概四个月。

sentences.en: We dated for a while.
sentences.zh: 我们约会了一段时间。

sentences.en: And then, honestly, this musical relationship was sort of our way back to friendship.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这种音乐上的关系是我们重回友谊的一种方式。

sentences.en: So I was working on this story called Miss Manhattan, and it was a story about the most famous model in all of New York.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在做一个叫《曼哈顿小姐》的故事，讲的是纽约最著名的模特的故事。

sentences.en: She appears on statues all over the city and also in other cities across America.
sentences.zh: 她出现在全城乃至全美其他城市的雕像上。

sentences.en: She was a famous artist model.
sentences.zh: 她是一位著名的艺术家模特。

sentences.en: And this was a story about one woman's life.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于一个女人一生的故事。

sentences.en: And it was very dramatic and more cinematic than anything I'd tried to cover in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 它非常戏剧化，比我过去尝试报道的任何内容都更具电影感。

sentences.en: And I realized that a lot of the music beds we used were, like, these rhythmic jams that sort of keep you humming along.
sentences.zh: 我意识到我们使用的很多背景音乐都是那种节奏感强的循环乐，让你跟着哼唱。

sentences.en: But this was a story with real high highs and low lows.
sentences.zh: 但这个故事有真正的高潮和低谷。

sentences.en: Like, I wanted it to be scored almost like a film.
sentences.zh: 我想让它像电影一样配乐。

sentences.en: So I didn't know a lot of musicians.
sentences.zh: 但我认识的音乐人不多。

sentences.en: And I thought of Sean.
sentences.zh: 我想到了肖恩。

sentences.en: For Avery to be like, would you want to make some music for 99% Invisible?
sentences.zh: 当艾弗里问我，你想为《99%隐形》做点音乐吗？

sentences.en: I was just like, whoa.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，哇。

sentences.en: It felt, yeah, it's like a dream come true.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像梦想成真了。

sentences.en: The thing that I thought could never actually be a real thing was actually possible.
sentences.zh: 我以为永远不可能实现的事情，竟然真的变成了可能。

sentences.en: I mean, working with Sean felt like mixing paint for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，与肖恩合作感觉就像第一次调色一样。

sentences.en: You know, before it felt a little paint by numbers.
sentences.zh: 你知道，以前感觉有点像按数字填色。

sentences.en: We're like, okay, you know, this is a good song we like to use when things get happy.
sentences.zh: 我们就像，好吧，这是一首我们喜欢在开心时用的好歌。

sentences.en: And this is a good, like, plodding, talky-talk song.
sentences.zh: 这是一首适合那种平淡、谈话类的歌。

sentences.en: I used to call the genre Thought Corps.
sentences.zh: 我过去把这种类型称为“思想核心”。

sentences.en: That was like, then you add the plinky plunks.
sentences.zh: 然后你再加点叮叮咚咚的声音。

sentences.en: They're like, boop-a-doop-a-doop, like music to talk over.
sentences.zh: 就像那种适合在说话时作为背景的音乐。

sentences.en: And then Sean was able to address all of these different nuances and the ways a story can take a turn.
sentences.zh: 而肖恩能够处理所有这些细微差别，以及故事转折的方式。

sentences.en: You can have music that moves with the narrative.
sentences.zh: 你可以拥有随叙事而动的音乐。

sentences.en: And I didn't even realize how badly I wanted that.
sentences.zh: 我甚至没意识到我有多渴望这一点。

sentences.en: You know, when you're talking about stories about buildings and stories about objects, it's like weirdly more complicated.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你谈论关于建筑和物体的故事时，它会变得出奇地复杂。

sentences.en: It's not like, and this is where it was sad and this is where it was excited and happy.
sentences.zh: 不是说，这里很悲伤，这里很兴奋、很开心。

sentences.en: It's always, you know, it's like, oh, can we make it like a ponderous but a little dark?
sentences.zh: 总是，你知道，就像，哦，我们能让它听起来沉思但又带点阴郁吗？

sentences.en: Can we make it exhilarating but also a little sinister?
sentences.zh: 我们能让它听起来令人振奋但又带点邪恶吗？

sentences.en: They're just like, yeah, it felt like mixing paint.
sentences.zh: 他们只是说，是的，感觉就像在调色。

sentences.en: It felt like Sean was helping make new colors.
sentences.zh: 感觉肖恩在帮我创造新的颜色。

sentences.en: I love collaborating with people.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢与人合作。

sentences.en: And I think that's like one of the things I love so much about this job, about working for the show,
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我热爱这份工作、热爱为这个节目工作的原因之一，

sentences.en: is that like everything that I write is like, you know, it's like it's for the show, but it's also like very much for the person who's like producing the episode.
sentences.zh: 就是我写的每一段音乐，既是为了节目，也是为了那个制作这一集的人。

sentences.en: And over the years, I like worked with all the producers and was developing, developing our like working relationships with like what,
sentences.zh: 多年来，我与所有制作人合作，发展出了我们的工作关系，了解什么，

sentences.en: what kind of music like works for which people.
sentences.zh: 什么样的音乐适合什么样的人。

sentences.en: Like, for example, Emmett or Vivian might ask me to make something that would highlight how silly or delightful something is.
sentences.zh: 例如，埃米特（Emmett）或薇薇安（Vivian）可能会让我做一些能突出某件事有多傻或多可爱的东西。

sentences.en: Katie might want music that is more neutral but has a cool beat.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂（Katie）可能想要更中性但节奏感很酷的音乐。

sentences.en: And I felt like I could always count on Avery to really, you know, want to pull me in a new direction, you know, to be like, let's do something experimental, you know,
sentences.zh: 我觉得我总是可以指望艾弗里，她真的会想把我带向一个新的方向，比如，让我们做点实验性的东西，

sentences.en: like let's really blow their minds this time.
sentences.zh: 让我们这次真的让大家大吃一惊。

sentences.en: And I was sad to think that I'd be losing that with Avery when she started working on Articles of Interest, which is the 99PI show about clothes.
sentences.zh: 当艾弗里开始制作《兴趣文章》（关于服装的《99%隐形》衍生节目）时，想到会失去这种合作，我很难过。

sentences.en: Avery was working with a different musician to score it, Ray Royal.
sentences.zh: 艾弗里当时找了另一位音乐人雷·罗亚尔（Ray Royal）来配乐。

sentences.en: But lucky for me, Avery decided she wanted to bring me back for this one crucial song.
sentences.zh: 但幸运的是，艾弗里决定让我回来制作这首关键的歌曲。

sentences.en: I wanted to start off with the launching point, like why talk about textiles at all?
sentences.zh: 我想从切入点开始，为什么非要谈论纺织品呢？

sentences.en: And it began with the origin of the computer and the computer punch card, which came from a loom.
sentences.zh: 它始于计算机和计算机打孔卡的起源，而打孔卡源自织布机。

sentences.en: A loom was arguably the first computer.
sentences.zh: 织布机可以说是第一台计算机。

sentences.en: It was the first to have an automated form of weaving.
sentences.zh: 它是第一个拥有自动化编织形式的机器。

sentences.en: And that's where the punch card came from that eventually led to the computer.
sentences.zh: 这就是打孔卡的来源，最终导致了计算机的诞生。

sentences.en: And so this felt extremely like wheelhouse 99PI.
sentences.zh: 所以这感觉非常符合《99%隐形》的风格。

sentences.en: That's a cool fact.
sentences.zh: 那是个很酷的事实。

sentences.en: That's a cool story to get people into the series.
sentences.zh: 那是个吸引人们进入这个系列的好故事。

sentences.en: And then as I was learning about punch cards, I was like, oh, this is also the same technology that makes music boxes.
sentences.zh: 当我了解打孔卡时，我想，哦，这和制作音乐盒的技术是一样的。

sentences.en: It would be kind of cool to have a music box sound so that people would be like, oh, punch cards.
sentences.zh: 如果能有音乐盒的声音会很酷，这样人们就会想，哦，打孔卡。

sentences.en: I know what those are.
sentences.zh: 我知道那是什么。

sentences.en: If you've seen a player piano or a music box, it's that exact same technology where there's a hole or not a hole, you know, basically the equivalent of one or zero.
sentences.zh: 如果你见过自动钢琴或音乐盒，它们的技术完全一样，有孔或没孔，基本上相当于一或零。

sentences.en: And that decides if there's going to be a note there or not.
sentences.zh: 这决定了那里是否会有音符。

sentences.en: So I turned to Sean and I was like, could you make a music box song?
sentences.zh: 所以我转向肖恩说，你能做一首音乐盒的歌吗？

sentences.en: And immediately I was like, oh, yes, like I want to do that.
sentences.zh: 我立刻就想，哦，是的，我想做那个。

sentences.en: Like, OK, how can I make a music box kick ass?
sentences.zh: 好吧，我该怎么让音乐盒听起来很棒呢？

sentences.en: And Avery didn't just want, you know, something that sounded like a music box.
sentences.zh: 艾弗里想要的不仅仅是听起来像音乐盒的东西。

sentences.en: Avery wanted the real thing.
sentences.zh: 艾弗里想要真实的东西。

sentences.en: So she gave me this children's make your own music box kit.
sentences.zh: 所以她给了我这个儿童自制音乐盒套件。

sentences.en: So I like ordered it to the office like, all right, here's the music box I ordered for you.
sentences.zh: 我把它订到了办公室，说，好吧，这是我为你订的音乐盒。

sentences.en: Go make a song for articles of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 去为《兴趣文章》写首歌吧。

sentences.en: And the music box isn't really like an instrument so much as it's a machine.
sentences.zh: 音乐盒与其说是一种乐器，不如说是一台机器。

sentences.en: You program it by punching holes in these little punch cards.
sentences.zh: 你通过在这些小打孔卡上打孔来编程。

sentences.en: And then you run those through it as you turn a hand crank.
sentences.zh: 然后当你转动手柄时，把它们穿过机器。

sentences.en: And the holes from the punch cards trigger little tines in the music box.
sentences.zh: 打孔卡上的孔会触发音乐盒里的小齿片。

sentences.en: Each tine produces a note and you have to punch the holes in exactly the right place to get the right note and also get the right rhythm.
sentences.zh: 每个音齿都会发出一个音符，你必须在完全正确的位置打孔，才能得到正确的音符，并把握好节奏。

sentences.en: I didn't want to, you know, start punching holes until I knew what the song was, you know, what I wanted the song to sound like.
sentences.zh: 我不想在还没确定这首歌是什么样子，或者说我想要这首歌听起来是什么样之前，就贸然开始打孔。

sentences.en: And so I started out by making a few demos on the computer using a digital instrument in place of the music box.
sentences.zh: 所以我先在电脑上用数字乐器代替八音盒，做了几个小样。

sentences.en: And I was really thinking, you know, like, I was really thinking of this as like a way to introduce this new series with a bang.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的在想，这可以作为一种震撼的方式来引出这个新系列。

sentences.en: Like, you know, like, how do I, how do I like make a walk on song for Avery?
sentences.zh: 就像，我该怎么为Avery制作一首出场曲呢？

sentences.en: But then, then pretty quickly, I was like, this is kind of cheesy, actually.
sentences.zh: 但很快我就觉得，这其实有点俗气。

sentences.en: And I'm leaning in a little too hard to that.
sentences.zh: 而且我在这方面用力过猛了。

sentences.en: And actually, the music box part is barely in this demo.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这个小样里几乎没怎么用到八音盒的声音。

sentences.en: And so then I came up with another idea that was like, you know, a lot more driven by the music box, you know, and sounded more like a music box.
sentences.zh: 于是我有了另一个想法，让音乐更多地由八音盒驱动，听起来更像八音盒。

sentences.en: But then I thought it sounded too much like a music box.
sentences.zh: 但后来我觉得它听起来太像八音盒了。

sentences.en: Like, it just makes me think of every music box you see in a movie is like a porcelain ballerina slowly spinning.
sentences.zh: 就像电影里看到的每一个八音盒，都是一个瓷芭蕾舞女演员在缓缓旋转。

sentences.en: And I was just like, how can we make it sound, you know, a little more unique?
sentences.zh: 我就在想，我们怎么能让它听起来更独特一点呢？

sentences.en: How can I make the music box actually feel like it is less of a toy and more of like an instrument?
sentences.zh: 我该如何让八音盒感觉不再像个玩具，而更像一件乐器？

sentences.en: How can I make it like, like a valid instrument in an orchestra?
sentences.zh: 我该如何让它像管弦乐队中的一件正式乐器一样？

sentences.en: And so that's where the third idea came from.
sentences.zh: 这就是第三个想法的由来。

sentences.en: Um, it's interesting, this one like kind of accomplishes on paper, all of the things I wanted to do, you know, make a music box, lead an orchestra.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很有趣，这个想法在纸面上实现了我想要的所有目标，你知道的，制作一个八音盒，指挥一个管弦乐队。

sentences.en: Except that it like, it kind of lost that sort of like kicking ass, like walk on song feeling.
sentences.zh: 只是它失去了一种那种酷炫的、出场曲的感觉。

sentences.en: But then some day later, I was in the shower.
sentences.zh: 但几天后，我在洗澡的时候。

sentences.en: And I just like, started hearing this kind of like circular melody in my head.
sentences.zh: 脑海里突然响起了一种循环的旋律。

sentences.en: You know, and I, there was like this line in the episode, like in the script about going around and around like the, the punch guard programming for like a player piano or a,
sentences.zh: 你知道，剧本里有一句台词是关于绕圈子的，就像自动钢琴或八音盒，或者老式计算机的打孔卡编程一样。

sentences.en: you know, or a, or a music box or an old computer.
sentences.zh: 或者是一个八音盒，或者是一台老式计算机。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, I think I have it.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，哦，我想我找到了。

sentences.en: And so I just like ran to my keyboard to like, to just like get this idea out.
sentences.zh: 于是我跑到键盘前，想把这个想法记录下来。

sentences.en: The way the notes, you know, circle around, it feels, you know, it kind of feels to me like, like turning the crank of the music box.
sentences.zh: 音符循环往复的方式，让我感觉就像在转动八音盒的发条。

sentences.en: But remember, I wrote this on the computer.
sentences.zh: 但别忘了，这是我在电脑上写的。

sentences.en: So the next step was to program the actual music box that Avery gave me to play the part.
sentences.zh: 所以下一步就是给Avery给我的那个真正的八音盒编程，让它演奏这段旋律。

sentences.en: I took my time because, you know, I wanted to be really careful and make sure I wasn't going to punch any holes in the wrong places.
sentences.zh: 我花了很多时间，因为我想非常小心，确保不会在错误的地方打孔。

sentences.en: But eventually I finished poking holes in the paper and I tested it out.
sentences.zh: 但最终我还是在纸带上打好了孔，并进行了测试。

sentences.en: And I think what was really magical was just hearing like this music that I had made in the ephemeral computer world being made by this tangible little machine.
sentences.zh: 我觉得最神奇的地方在于，听到我在虚幻的电脑世界里创作的音乐，竟然由这个实实在在的小机器演奏了出来。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I felt like I had really made something.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我真的创造出了什么东西。

sentences.en: And the next step was to record it.
sentences.zh: 下一步就是把它录下来。

sentences.en: And I wanted the music box to start out slow and then, you know, kind of gradually speed up.
sentences.zh: 我希望八音盒开始时慢一点，然后逐渐加快速度。

sentences.en: And so to do that, I recorded a few different takes at different speeds.
sentences.zh: 为了做到这一点，我以不同的速度录制了几个版本。

sentences.en: And the first one I did was really slow.
sentences.zh: 第一个版本我录得很慢。

sentences.en: You can actually like really hear the little gears turning and the little like squeak from the crank.
sentences.zh: 你甚至能清楚地听到小齿轮转动的声音，还有发条发出的吱吱声。

sentences.en: I really like loved that sound.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢那个声音。

sentences.en: I love when you can like hear component parts of a sound.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那种能听到声音组成部分的感觉。

sentences.en: Like you don't just hear like the sound, but you hear what's making the sound.
sentences.zh: 就像你不只是听到了声音，还能听到是什么在发出这种声音。

sentences.en: I love hearing like the strings of like a violin or something, like that kind of scrape of the bow.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢听到小提琴琴弦的声音，或者类似那种琴弓摩擦的声音。

sentences.en: Maybe I could have done some kind of stuff to like lessen the squeak.
sentences.zh: 也许我本可以做些什么来减少那种吱吱声。

sentences.en: But I love the squeak.
sentences.zh: 但我喜欢那种吱吱声。

sentences.en: I just wanted to let it be as squeaky as it was.
sentences.zh: 我只想让它保持原样，保留那份吱吱作响。

sentences.en: And then I did another one that was a little bit faster.
sentences.zh: 然后我又录了一个稍微快一点的版本。

sentences.en: And I had a tempo in mind that I wanted to build to, that I wanted the other instruments to come up over.
sentences.zh: 我心里有一个预想的节奏，我想以此为基础，让其他乐器在上面叠加。

sentences.en: And in order to get it to go that fast, I had to like crank it really faSt.
sentences.zh: 为了达到那个速度，我必须转得非常快。

sentences.en: And this tiny little crank is not very ergonomic.
sentences.zh: 而这个小小的发条把手并不符合人体工程学。

sentences.en: So I'm just like, and it was like, there was a moment where I was like, I'm not going to be able to keep this up like consistently enough to have like a consistent rhythm.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时就在想，有一瞬间我觉得我无法保持足够稳定的速度来获得一个连贯的节奏。

sentences.en: It's just going to sound like a mess.
sentences.zh: 听起来只会是一团糟。

sentences.en: So I had to practice it a lot before I could like get a, get a good recording of like the fast take.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须反复练习，才能录出一个好的快速版本。

sentences.en: I'm not sure if like, you know, anybody would like listen to that, the music box on its own and think like driving.
sentences.zh: 我不确定是否有人会单独听那个八音盒的声音，然后觉得它很有驱动力。

sentences.en: But like, when I hear that, I like hear, that's what the rhythm is doing to me.
sentences.zh: 但当我听到它时，我能感觉到，这就是节奏带给我的感觉。

sentences.en: Those are like this, that's the syncopation that like, that I can hear in my head.
sentences.zh: 这就是我脑海中能听到的切分音。

sentences.en: And so that's naturally how I started playing the next instrument.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我自然而然开始演奏下一件乐器的方式。

sentences.en: I really love contrast in music.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢音乐中的对比。

sentences.en: So I wanted the next instrument that you hear to be like the polar opposite of the music box.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你听到的下一件乐器能与八音盒形成鲜明对比。

sentences.en: So I got my standup bass and just started like going da, da, da, da, da, da.
sentences.zh: 于是我拿起了我的立式低音提琴，开始弹奏：哒、哒、哒、哒、哒、哒。

sentences.en: Like choppy, you know, just like driving eighth notes.
sentences.zh: 那种断奏，你知道的，就像强劲的八分音符。

sentences.en: And then I really wanted to like emphasize that chop.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想强调那种断奏感。

sentences.en: So I also like did a really high note on the bass so that the, the cutting, that cutting rhythm would be like unmistakable or something.
sentences.zh: 所以我还在低音提琴上弹了一个很高的音，这样那种切割感、那种节奏感就会变得非常明显。

sentences.en: And so then just, just as I brought in this like harsh choppy bass in order to counter the pretty little music box,
sentences.zh: 所以，就在我引入这种尖锐、断奏的低音来对抗优美的八音盒时，

sentences.en: I wanted to counter that choppy sound with long, very pretty tones from the cello.
sentences.zh: 我想用大提琴悠长、非常优美的音调来平衡那种断奏的声音。

sentences.en: So this cello belongs to one of my old bandmates and she was nice enough to let me borrow it for this.
sentences.zh: 这把大提琴属于我以前的一位乐队成员，她很慷慨地借给我用。

sentences.en: It just has this really like full and woody sound that I love.
sentences.zh: 它有一种我非常喜欢的饱满而富有木质感的声音。

sentences.en: I had all these other like ideas for other instruments to come into and like bring it to the next place and like have a huge crashing ending.
sentences.zh: 我还有很多关于其他乐器加入的想法，想把音乐推向下一个阶段，并有一个巨大的、震撼的结尾。

sentences.en: But something that I've like consistently learned from this job is that less is more.
sentences.zh: 但我从这份工作中一直学到的一点是：少即是多。

sentences.en: And a lot of times it makes like just as much sense or more sense, you know, to get something that's good and then quit while you're ahead.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，在达到一个好的效果后适可而止，往往更有意义。

sentences.en: And now I really love how this song ends.
sentences.zh: 现在我真的很喜欢这首歌的结尾。

sentences.en: I'm really happy with how it ended up.
sentences.zh: 我对最终的效果非常满意。

sentences.en: I felt like with just like these few little components, I had really accomplished the things I had set out to do,
sentences.zh: 我觉得仅凭这几个小小的元素，我就真正完成了我设定的目标，

sentences.en: which were making the music box feel bigger and badder than it, you know, than you normally think of it.
sentences.zh: 那就是让八音盒听起来比你通常认为的更宏大、更酷。

sentences.en: And making a song that matched and played off of the content of the story and giving Avery this opening and closing of a chapter song for her opening and closing of a chapter series.
sentences.zh: 创作一首与故事内容相呼应的歌曲，并为Avery的系列节目提供了一首开场和结尾曲。

sentences.en: And when I was getting ready to play it for Avery, I always have just like a little bit of of worry that like, OK, like I know I'm proud of this,
sentences.zh: 当准备给Avery听的时候，我总是有一点担心，我知道我为它感到自豪，

sentences.en: but like the real test is like showing it to the producer, getting notes, getting my ego like checked a little bit.
sentences.zh: 但真正的考验是把它展示给制作人，听取意见，让我的自尊心受到一点点挑战。

sentences.en: So like even even with how proud I was of it, I was still protecting myself a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以即使我为它感到自豪，我还是在保护自己。

sentences.en: I was ready to sort of be like, OK, it doesn't mean that you're a bad musician.
sentences.zh: 我已经准备好接受这样的评价：好吧，这并不意味着你是个糟糕的音乐家。

sentences.en: It just means that this is a process.
sentences.zh: 这只是意味着这是一个过程。

sentences.en: The process of making Articles of Interest was really all over the place.
sentences.zh: 制作《Articles of Interest》的过程确实非常混乱。

sentences.en: And I remember one day I was feeling like really scared and nervous about Articles of Interest and if it would all come together in time.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一天，我对《Articles of Interest》感到非常害怕和紧张，担心它是否能及时完成。

sentences.en: And I remember Sean being like, hey, I want to show you something.
sentences.zh: 我记得Sean说：嘿，我想给你看点东西。

sentences.en: And she brought me into her office.
sentences.zh: 她把我带进了她的办公室。

sentences.en: And from my memory, you played the song for me and it was just like already done.
sentences.zh: 在我的记忆中，你为我播放了这首歌，它就像已经完成了一样。

sentences.en: It was like immaculate conception, perfect.
sentences.zh: 就像圣灵感孕一样，完美无瑕。

sentences.en: And I remember the minute you played it for me when the bass kicked in, I started crying and I was like, Sean, it's perfect.
sentences.zh: 我记得你为我播放的那一刻，当低音响起时，我开始哭泣，我说：Sean，它太完美了。

sentences.en: And I remember it made me feel so calm.
sentences.zh: 我记得它让我感到非常平静。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, maybe this will be good.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，哦，也许这会很不错。

sentences.en: Like maybe this series will be good.
sentences.zh: 也许这个系列会很成功。

sentences.en: And then putting it under that moment when like Roman handed the series off to me, it was like, oh, yeah, like this is this is great.
sentences.zh: 然后把它放在Roman把系列节目交给我那一刻的背景里，感觉真是太棒了。

sentences.en: This rules.
sentences.zh: 这太酷了。

sentences.en: When you crank the gear of a music box, you can make the tune go as fast or as slowly as you want.
sentences.zh: 当你转动八音盒的发条时，你可以随心所欲地让曲调变快或变慢。

sentences.en: As you spin the little handle around and around and around.
sentences.zh: 随着你转动那个小把手，一圈又一圈。

sentences.en: The music is read from this series of little bumps like Braille.
sentences.zh: 音乐是通过这一系列像盲文一样的小凸起读取出来的。

sentences.en: Producer Avery Truffelman.
sentences.zh: 制作人Avery Truffelman。

sentences.en: These little bumps stick up and they hit a series of tines which create a song.
sentences.zh: 这些小凸起向上突出，撞击一系列音齿，从而创作出一首歌曲。

sentences.en: And it's funny, like I hear this song being used in other 99PI episodes sometimes and I always get really possessive.
sentences.zh: 很有趣，有时我在其他99PI剧集中听到这首歌被使用时，我总是会产生很强的占有欲。

sentences.en: I'm like, hey, you know, like you're dancing with my girl.
sentences.zh: 我会想：嘿，你在和我的女孩跳舞呢。

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: I mean, it's a great song.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一首很棒的歌。

sentences.en: I don't fault anyone else for using it.
sentences.zh: 我不怪其他人使用它。

sentences.en: It's like an amazing song.
sentences.zh: 这是一首了不起的歌。

sentences.en: But I do feel I do feel like I will duel you, sir.
sentences.zh: 但我确实觉得，先生，我会向你发起决斗。

sentences.en: Like she is mine.
sentences.zh: 她是我的。

sentences.en: This song.
sentences.zh: 这首歌。

sentences.en: So a bit after, after Articles of Interest was finished and it was becoming more clear that Avery would be leaving the show at some point.
sentences.zh: 在《Articles of Interest》完成后不久，Avery迟早要离开节目的事实变得越来越清晰。

sentences.en: You know, I had the music box and I felt like Avery should have it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我有那个八音盒，我觉得它应该属于Avery。

sentences.en: I felt like I wanted Avery to be able to hold on to this physical token of like the best that our working relationship had brought us.
sentences.zh: 我希望Avery能保留这个实体的纪念品，作为我们工作关系中最美好回忆的见证。

sentences.en: And so I had a friend of mine actually make a little wooden case to put the, to put the little music box machine inside of.
sentences.zh: 所以我找了一个朋友做了一个小木盒，把那个八音盒机器放进去。

sentences.en: And so I had like an actual, like, you know, like nice little wooden music box that I, that I gave to Avery as a gift.
sentences.zh: 所以我得到了一个真正精美的木制八音盒，我把它作为礼物送给了Avery。

sentences.en: And I have the box here.
sentences.zh: 我把盒子带到这里了。

sentences.en: It's the music box.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个八音盒。

sentences.en: If I keep playing it, it's going to make me cry.
sentences.zh: 如果我继续弹奏它，我会哭出来的。

sentences.en: Like, honestly, this is my little rosebud moment.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这就是我的“玫瑰花蕾”时刻。

sentences.en: And I, oh my God, I hear this music box and it makes me think about Oakland.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我听到这个八音盒的声音，就想起了奥克兰。

sentences.en: It's like the most beautiful song in the world.
sentences.zh: 这是世界上最美的歌。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: And now here's the loom in its entirety.
sentences.zh: 现在，这就是完整的《Loom》。

sentences.en: This bonus episode of 99% Invisible was produced by Emmett Fitzgerald and mixed by Bryson Barnes.
sentences.zh: 这期99% Invisible的特别节目由Emmett Fitzgerald制作，Bryson Barnes混音。

sentences.en: Music, very clearly, by Sean Rial.
sentences.zh: 音乐，显而易见，由Sean Rial创作。

sentences.en: Additional music by Penina Eilberg-Schwartz.
sentences.zh: 额外音乐由Penina Eilberg-Schwartz提供。

sentences.en: Special thanks this week to Ash Clayton, Sophia Bell, and our good friend Avery Truffelman.
sentences.zh: 本周特别感谢Ash Clayton、Sophia Bell以及我们的好朋友Avery Truffelman。

sentences.en: Avery now hosts the podcast The Cut from New York Magazine.
sentences.zh: Avery现在主持《纽约杂志》的播客《The Cut》。

sentences.en: It is fantastic.
sentences.zh: 它非常棒。

sentences.en: If you don't already listen to it, I highly recommend you listen to it because you need more Avery Truffelman in your life.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没听过，我强烈推荐你去听，因为你的生活中需要更多Avery Truffelman的声音。

sentences.en: Also, I mentioned this in the intro, but Rishi's podcast has recently been turned into a Netflix show.
sentences.zh: 另外，我在开场白中提到过，Rishi的播客最近被改编成了Netflix节目。

sentences.en: And although I continue to think that Song Exploder is the perfect concept for a podcast,
sentences.zh: 虽然我一直认为《Song Exploder》是播客的完美概念，

sentences.en: I'm here to tell you that it works incredibly well on television, too.
sentences.zh: 但我可以告诉你，它在电视上也表现得非常出色。

sentences.en: There are episodes up right now with Alicia Keys and Ty Dolla $ign and R.E.M.
sentences.zh: 现在已经有Alicia Keys、Ty Dolla $ign和R.E.M.的剧集了。

sentences.en: I have been enjoying them with the boys.
sentences.zh: 我和孩子们一直很喜欢看。

sentences.en: They are great for the whole family.
sentences.zh: 它们非常适合全家一起观看。

sentences.en: And we have a very special announcement of our own.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一个非常特别的公告。

sentences.en: We produced a 7-inch record of music that Sean has written for the show over the past few years.
sentences.zh: 我们制作了一张7英寸黑胶唱片，收录了Sean过去几年为节目创作的音乐。

sentences.en: So if you've ever wanted to hear 99PI music on its own without me talking over it, I highly recommend this album.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你曾经想在没有我说话干扰的情况下单独欣赏99PI的音乐，我强烈推荐这张专辑。

sentences.en: The 7-inch is a beautiful object.
sentences.zh: 这张7英寸唱片是一件精美的艺术品。

sentences.en: It's filled with gorgeous instrumental music that's great to work to or to cook to or to do dishes to or just to help you relax in your apartment.
sentences.zh: 它充满了美妙的器乐，非常适合工作、烹饪、洗碗时听，或者仅仅是在公寓里放松时听。

sentences.en: We also have a digital version that you can download when you pay a little bit of money.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一个数字版本，你只需支付一点费用就可以下载。

sentences.en: But I also, I really hope you get the record.
sentences.zh: 但我真的希望你能买这张唱片。

sentences.en: The record is really special.
sentences.zh: 这张唱片非常特别。

sentences.en: I think it would make a great gift this holiday season.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它会是这个节日季的一份很棒的礼物。

sentences.en: You can purchase Sean's 7-inch right now.
sentences.zh: 你现在就可以购买Sean的这张7英寸唱片。

sentences.en: Just click on the Shop tab on our website at 99PI.org.
sentences.zh: 只需点击我们网站99PI.org上的“商店”标签即可。

sentences.en: And speaking of new stuff, coming up after the break, we've got an extended preview of a brand new 99PI spinoff series that is dropping next month.
sentences.zh: 说到新内容，休息过后，我们将带来下个月即将推出的全新99PI衍生系列的加长预告片。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听。

sentences.en: And now a preview of 99% Invisible's new limited series, According to Need.
sentences.zh: 现在是99% Invisible新限定系列《According to Need》的预告片。

sentences.en: A little over five years ago, I moved across the country to take a job in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 五年多前，我搬到了全国的另一端，在美丽的加州奥克兰市中心找了一份工作。

sentences.en: I didn't realize I was part of a trend, but I was.
sentences.zh: 我当时没意识到自己正处于一种趋势之中，但我确实是。

sentences.en: Thousands of other people were also moving to the Bay Area for work.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人也为了工作搬到了湾区。

sentences.en: The cost of rent skyrocketed.
sentences.zh: 租金成本飞涨。

sentences.en: And over the course of about five years, homelessness in the county where I live doubled.
sentences.zh: 在大约五年的时间里，我所居住的县的无家可归者人数翻了一番。

sentences.en: All over town, you can see the effects of this, almost as if a tidal wave of wealth washed people out of their houses and into the streets, into tents and RVs and cars.
sentences.zh: 在整个城市，你都能看到这种影响，仿佛一股财富的浪潮将人们从家中冲走，流落街头，住进帐篷、房车和汽车里。

sentences.en: I know these people right here.
sentences.zh: 我认识这些人。

sentences.en: I know these people right here.
sentences.zh: 我认识这些人。

sentences.en: I know them people right there.
sentences.zh: 我认识那些人。

sentences.en: All homeless?
sentences.zh: 都无家可归吗？

sentences.en: All homeless in their cars.
sentences.zh: 他们都住在车里，无家可归。

sentences.en: They're renting not apartments, they're not bedrooms, beds for $1,200 a month near the college.
sentences.zh: 他们租的不是公寓，也不是卧室，只是大学附近每月1200美元的床位。

sentences.en: That's outrageous.
sentences.zh: 这太离谱了。

sentences.en: It's hard to get out of this s**t when you're homeless.
sentences.zh: 一旦无家可归，就很难摆脱这种困境。

sentences.en: You don't know what your life is going to be the next two hours.
sentences.zh: 你根本不知道接下来的两个小时生活会变成什么样。

sentences.en: You know, it just like swallows you up.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那种感觉就像被吞噬了一样。

sentences.en: Mom?
sentences.zh: 妈妈？

sentences.en: Yeah?
sentences.zh: 怎么了？

sentences.en: You know what I think about?
sentences.zh: 你知道我在想什么吗？

sentences.en: What'd you think about, Daddy?
sentences.zh: 你在想什么，爸爸？

sentences.en: We need a house.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一个家。

sentences.en: Given just the sheer scale of homelessness all over the U.S., but in the Bay Area in particular,
sentences.zh: 考虑到全美，尤其是湾区无家可归问题的严重程度，

sentences.en: you could be forgiven for thinking there was no system in place to address it.
sentences.zh: 你可能会以为根本没有相应的系统来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: But you'd be wrong.
sentences.zh: 但你错了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for hoping.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您抱有希望。

sentences.en: How can I assist you today?
sentences.zh: 今天我能为您提供什么帮助？

sentences.en: Yes, me and my 11-year-old son is homeless.
sentences.zh: 是的，我和我11岁的儿子无家可归。

sentences.en: There is actually a system to help people out of homelessness.
sentences.zh: 实际上确实有一个系统可以帮助人们摆脱无家可归的状态。

sentences.en: But it doesn't help everyone.
sentences.zh: 但它并不能帮助所有人。

sentences.en: What does it take to be priority for them?
sentences.zh: 他们优先考虑的标准是什么？

sentences.en: I don't understand it.
sentences.zh: 我不明白。

sentences.en: So they get you on the liSt.
sentences.zh: 他们会把你列入名单。

sentences.en: They're very good at getting people on lists.
sentences.zh: 他们非常擅长把人列入名单。

sentences.en: How this system works is confusing and opaque.
sentences.zh: 这个系统的运作方式既令人困惑又不透明。

sentences.en: Some might say Kafka-esque.
sentences.zh: 有人可能会说这简直是卡夫卡式的。

sentences.en: It's all a huge mystery.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是个巨大的谜团。

sentences.en: I mean, we're like, you know, professionals here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们好歹也是专业人士。

sentences.en: You know, we have law degrees.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们都有法律学位。

sentences.en: And we can't figure out what's going on and can't get a hold of people.
sentences.zh: 但我们却搞不清楚到底是怎么回事，也联系不上相关人员。

sentences.en: I spent a long time trying to understand this system.
sentences.zh: 我花了很多时间试图理解这个系统。

sentences.en: Yeah, it feels a little bit like the Wizard of Oz.
sentences.zh: 是啊，感觉有点像《绿野仙踪》。

sentences.en: I guess my first question is, like, are you the wizard?
sentences.zh: 我想我的第一个问题是，你是那个巫师吗？

sentences.en: Is this Oz?
sentences.zh: 这里是奥兹国吗？

sentences.en: I do have a map of Oz.
sentences.zh: 我确实有一张奥兹国的地图。

sentences.en: There are hundreds of thousands of people experiencing homelessness in the United States.
sentences.zh: 在美国，有成千上万的人正经历着无家可归。

sentences.en: And COVID could make things even worse.
sentences.zh: 而新冠疫情可能会让情况变得更糟。

sentences.en: So what are we doing about it?
sentences.zh: 那么我们对此做了些什么呢？

sentences.en: According to Need is a special documentary series from 99% Invisible
sentences.zh: 《根据需求》（According to Need）是《99%隐形》（99% Invisible）推出的一部特别纪录片系列，

sentences.en: that looks at the system we have to get people back inside.
sentences.zh: 它审视了我们现有的帮助人们重返住所的系统。

sentences.en: Find it in your 99PI podcast feed on December 1St.
sentences.zh: 请在12月1日的《99%隐形》播客订阅源中收听。

sentences.en: So when are you going to wrap all of this up?
sentences.zh: 那你打算什么时候结束这一切？

sentences.en: Like, what is 99% Invisible?
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》到底是什么？

sentences.en: Like, is it a magazine?
sentences.zh: 是杂志吗？

sentences.en: Is it a radio?
sentences.zh: 是广播吗？

sentences.en: Like, what are we doing?
sentences.zh: 我们到底在做什么？

sentences.en: I am so excited for you to hear Katie's new series.
sentences.zh: 我非常期待你们听到凯蒂的新系列节目。

sentences.en: It is incredible.
sentences.zh: 它太棒了。

sentences.en: Just keep up to date on this feed and you will get it automatically.
sentences.zh: 只要关注这个订阅源，你就能自动获取更新。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW in San Francisco and produced on Radio Row,
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7 KALW电台的一个项目，在“广播街”（Radio Row）制作，

sentences.en: which lives in various corners of North America,
sentences.zh: 它存在于北美洲的各个角落，

sentences.en: but is centered in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 但中心位于美丽的加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心。

sentences.en: We are a founding member of Radiotopia from PRX,
sentences.zh: 我们是PRX旗下Radiotopia的创始成员，

sentences.en: a fiercely independent collective of the most innovative,
sentences.zh: 这是一个极具独立精神的集体，汇集了全球最具创新性、

sentences.en: listener-supported, 100% artist-owned podcasts in the world.
sentences.zh: 由听众支持、100%由艺术家拥有的播客。

sentences.en: Find them all at radiotopia.fm.
sentences.zh: 请访问 radiotopia.fm 了解详情。

sentences.en: You can tweet at me at Roman Mars in the show at 99PI.org,
sentences.zh: 你可以在推特上关注我 Roman Mars，或访问节目官网 99PI.org，

sentences.en: on Instagram and Reddit too.
sentences.zh: 也可以在Instagram和Reddit上找到我们。

sentences.en: You can order our first book,
sentences.zh: 你可以订购我们的第一本书，

sentences.en: The 99% Invisible City, at 99PI.org slash book.
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形城市》（The 99% Invisible City），网址是 99PI.org/book。

sentences.en: We have links to purchase it anywhere you get your books,
sentences.zh: 我们提供了购买链接，你可以在任何买书的地方找到它，

sentences.en: including signed editions and the audiobook too.
sentences.zh: 包括签名版和有声书。

sentences.en: For all your other 99PI needs, look no further.
sentences.zh: 关于《99%隐形》的所有其他需求，看这里就够了。

sentences.en: The 99PI.org.
sentences.zh: 99PI.org。

sentences.en: Radiotopia.
sentences.zh: Radiotopia。
